units.source_text: “小姐离开后，我好歹松了一口气，同时又涌起一股或失落或歉疚的心情。

en.t: After the young lady left, I somehow felt relieved, and at the same time a feeling rose in me, something like disappointment or guilt.

units.source_text: 也许我有些女人气，在你这个现代青年看来，恐怕更是如此。

en.t: Perhaps I was somewhat feminine; to a modern young man like you, I probably seem even more so.

units.source_text: 可我们那个时代的年轻人大都是这样的。

en.t: But most young people of our time were like that.

units.source_text: 夫人很少外出，即便偶尔出门，也绝不会让小姐和我单独留在家里。

en.t: The lady of the house rarely went out, and even when she occasionally did, she would never leave the young lady and me alone at home.

units.source_text: 我不知道这是偶然的，还是有意的。

en.t: I did not know whether this was accidental or intentional.

units.source_text: 这话从我嘴里说出，虽然不太合适，

en.t: Although it is not quite proper for me to say this myself,

units.source_text: 可我仔细观察夫人的举止，似乎有心让小姐和我接近，

en.t: when I observed her behavior carefully, it seemed as though she meant to bring the young lady and me closer together,

units.source_text: 可有的时候又似乎对我心怀戒备。

en.t: yet at other times she also seemed to be wary of me.

units.source_text: 我初次遇到这种情况，心情时常很糟糕。

en.t: Encountering this kind of situation for the first time, I often felt quite miserable.

units.source_text: 我希望夫人能够明确一下态度，因为从大脑功能来看，这显然是互相矛盾的。

en.t: I wished she would make her attitude clear, because from the standpoint of reason it was plainly self-contradictory.

units.source_text: 然而，对受叔叔欺骗的事还记忆犹新的我，不能不抱有更深的猜忌。

en.t: But with the memory of being deceived by my uncle still fresh, I could not help harboring a deeper suspicion.

units.source_text: 我猜测夫人的态度到底哪个是真，哪个是假，却又判断不了。

en.t: I guessed that one of her attitudes must be true and the other false, but I could not tell which was which.

units.source_text: 不但判断不了，我还不理解夫人为什么做这么莫名其妙的事。

en.t: Not only could I not judge, I also could not understand why she would do something so inexplicable.

units.source_text: 我无论怎么想也想不出其理由，有时便将罪过统统归结于‘女人’，以此来说服自己。

en.t: No matter how I thought about it, I could not find a reason, and at times I persuaded myself by laying all the blame on women.

units.source_text: 毕竟是个女人，所以才会这么做，女人就是这么愚蠢。

en.t: After all, she was a woman, and that was why she acted that way; women were simply that foolish.

units.source_text: 每当我想不下去，便这样下结论。

en.t: Whenever my thoughts could go no further, I would arrive at that conclusion.
